It encompasses our ability to perceive the world around us, engage in mental processes, and have a sense of our own existence.

However, the question remains largely unexplained, with prominent theories including materialist views (like the Integrated Information Theory) and non-reductive approaches (like dualism or panpsychism).

In summary, the nature of consciousness is a multifaceted and mysterious aspect of human experience, deeply intertwined with the workings of the brain yet still shrouded in much debate and speculation.
